BEM is a class naming convention: Block, Element and Modifier.
Block එක standalone component එකයි. Element එක ඒ block එJකේ Jකාටසකේ. Modifier එක block Jහහෝ
element එJකේ Jවනස් state Jහහෝ variant එකකේ. Naming එJකන් styles හඳුනාගන්න පෙහසු Jවනවා.
A product card with a featured variant.

Read the diagram: Read the component boundary, the title inside it, and the featured variant.
Card block එක තුළ title element එකයි. Featured variant එකට Jවනම border එකකේ තිJයනවා.

Interview question: What does card__title--large represent?
